# Contributing

Thank you for contributing to this repository.

## Before opening a pull request

- Create a focused branch from the repository's integration branch.
- Run the same format, lint, type-check, build, test, and coverage commands used by `.github/workflows/ci.yml`.
- Update documentation and tests when behavior changes.
- Do not include secrets, generated credentials, unrelated formatting, or organization-specific assumptions.

## Pull requests

Use the pull-request template. Keep commits and descriptions clear, link relevant issues, and call out migrations, security implications, and follow-up work.
